name: tdarr-control
description: Control of a Tdarr distributed transcoding server (v2 API) + comprehensive transcoding/Tdarr knowledge base. LIVE-VERIFIED on Tdarr 2.84.01 (2026-07-20): 16/16 smoke tools + reversible backup write-proof. Generic passthrough over all 67 documented /api/v2 endpoints + ~30 curated tools. Skill ships 10 references (2,700+ lines): codecs encyclopedia (video/audio/subtitle/container + compatibility matrix), hardware acceleration (NVENC for RTX 3060 incl HDR preservation + Docker GPU passthrough + no-AV1-on-Ampere caveat), 6 canonical transcode workflows with real ffmpeg commands, 107-plugin community catalog organized by purpose, Tdarr 2.x flows with variable templating + global/library variables + Worker Type routing, advanced-features catalog (staging/review queue, F2F, hold-after-scan, schedules, auto-pause, stall detector, plugin SHA pinning, resolution boundaries, queue ordering, notifications, Tdarr Pro, bumped files, closed-caption detection), library + node config deep dive (incl. mapped vs unmapped nodes, path translators, 24-hour schedules, gpuSelect, custom thorough-health-check ffmpeg args), diagnostics + health checks (quick/thorough, statistics, job reports, footprint IDs, troubleshooting playbook), integrations (auth with seededApiKey, Discord webhooks, tdarr_inform from Sonarr/Radarr, tdarr_autoscan, Plex/Emby triggers, Heimdall/Homer). All writes confirm-gated; kill-worker/disconnect-node/kill-file-scanner doubly-gated.
